basic_details.job_title: DHS Yadgiri X-ray Technician/ Radiographers Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: 10th (SSLC) and Diploma in X-Ray/Medical Imaging Technology, or 10+2 (PUC) with Science (Physics, Chemistry & Biology) and Diploma in X-ray/Medical Imaging Technology, from an institution affiliated to RUGHS or approved by the Karnataka Paramedical Board
qualification.details: Qualification: 10th (SSLC) and Diploma in X-Ray/Medical imaging technology from an institution affiliated to RUGHS or approved by the Karnataka paramedical board; OR 10+2 (PUC) with Science (Physics, Chemistry & Biology) and Diploma in X-ray/Medical imaging Technology from an institution affiliated to RUGHS or approved by the Karnataka Paramedical board Age limit: Maximum 45 years

how_to_apply: Submit the prescribed application form online from 03-11-2026 to 13-11-2026.
Details of the posts are on http://yadgir.nic.in and http://zpyadgiri.karnataka.gov.in.
important_instructions: Of the 4 posts, 3 are under the Kalyana Karnataka circle (KK) and 1 under the Rest of the Parent Cadre (RPC)

content_sections.heading: District Health Society Yadgiri Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. DTC/YAD/NTEP/96/2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download District Health Society Yadgiri notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 10th (SSLC) and Diploma in X-Ray/Medical imaging technology from an institution affiliated to RUGHS or approved by the Karnataka paramedical board; OR 10+2 (PUC) with Science (Physics, Chemistry & Biology) and Diploma in X-ray/Medical imaging Technology from an institution affiliated to RUGHS or approved by the Karnataka Paramedical board Age limit: Maximum 45 years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Posts are NHM contract posts on contract basis Consolidated pay is subject to change as per the ROP issued from the state level from time to time

content_sections.heading: How Will District Health Society Yadgiri Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection on merit-cum-roster basis Merit-cum-roster basis

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates from recognised institutions Relevant caste certificate (valid) 371J certificate for candidates applying under the Kalyana Karnataka circle

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Health Society Yadgiri Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit the prescribed application form online from 03-11-2026 to 13-11-2026. Details of the posts are on http://yadgir.nic.in and http://zpyadgiri.karnataka.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Of the 4 posts, 3 are under the Kalyana Karnataka circle (KK) and 1 under the Rest of the Parent Cadre (RPC)

faq.answer: The last date is 13 November 2026. Applications opened on 3 November 2026.

faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 13 November 2026.

faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years.

faq.answer: Rs. 17,435 per month (consolidated).
